Daytime notice for anyone travelling with a pet
Someone on the desk wanted you to know
Pet travel guidance for today

If you are travelling with an animal, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you leave for the airport. We will help you check the travel papers, confirm the travel crate, and explain the steps that make boarding smoother for you and your pet. Our team gives clear guidance before departure so you can arrive prepared and feel settled.

During the journey, a cabin team monitors animals with care and attention. A welcome team also prepares passengers for boarding and helps keep the process calm at the gate. If your pet seems uneasy, our staff will do what they can to support a quiet and orderly handover. We want each traveller to feel informed, and we want each animal to travel safely and comfortably with Aurelia Skyways.

Please come to the desk if you need help with your plans, your documents, or your pet's travel arrangements.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
